theta0_anchor_limitation: theta0 is the task-0 checkpoint and is used as the historical functional anchor for theta1 and theta2. At theta2, theta0 does not encode the post-task-1 state; therefore the quantity is an anchor-to-theta0 retention direction rather than a complete all-old-tasks direction.
state_task_confound: theta1 uses incoming task T2 while theta2 uses incoming task T3. Therefore contains_7 × C(state) cannot isolate a pure checkpoint-state effect from an incoming-task effect.
